messages:
nate_sdk: FYI: multiple new users reported our JS SDK sample blows up on Vercel Edge after the package.json `exports` tweak we shipped. stack trace below. anyone oncall for exports/packaging?

lee_build: paste the stack? quick repro?

nate_sdk: Repro (minimal):
1) `npx create-redwood-playground && cd playground`
2) `npm i redwood-sdk@^3.0.0`
3) set `type: \"module\"` in package.json and deploy to edge runtime

Edge error: `Uncaught TypeError: (0 , _redwood.default) is not a constructor`
Bundler console: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'createClient')`
TS: `TS1192: Module '\"redwood-sdk\"' has no default export.`

Import in sample:```js
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
```

olivia_support: Some users reported a workaround: `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` or `const Redwood = require('redwood-sdk')` — but both are gross for ESM-first onboarding.

anya_ts: Did we accidentally remove the `./dist/esm` path from `exports`? I remember we added a `require`/`node` conditional to satisfy an internal CI image.

lee_build: I looked: current package.json exports has `\"default\": \"./dist/cjs/index.js\"`, `\"require\": \"./dist/cjs/index.js\"` and `\"node\": \"./dist/cjs/index.js\"`. There is no explicit `import`/`module`/`edge` mapping, so ESM-aware resolvers on the platform are resolving to CJS. That explains the interop break.

deps-bot: npm audit: package redwood-sdk@3.0.1 published 2 hours ago (contains export map change). See changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/compare/v3.0.0...v3.0.1

nate_sdk: Ugh. This blocks fresh sign-ups. Onboarding pages expect `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` to just work for modern ESM apps.

olivia_support: We already have two support tickets open from customers who hit this while poking the quickstart.

anya_ts: Proposed immediate fix: publish 3.0.2 that restores ESM-first exports like: `exports: { ".": { \"import\": \"./dist/esm/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/cjs/index.js\", \"types\": \"./dist/types/index.d.ts\", \"edge\": \"./dist/esm/index.mjs\" } }`. Also add `exports.types` mapping so TS consumers find declarations.

lee_build: Agreed. Also add a release CI check that installs the published tarball into a minimal `type:module` app and runs `tsc --noEmit` + a tiny Node 18 ESM invocation. We should validate the published package, not just the repo build.

nate_sdk: Short-term docs note: recommend `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` or pin to 3.0.0. But that's ugly — we should ship patch asap.

deps-bot: CI: packaging tests failed on canary deploys: 4/4 edge instances crashed with same error (see: https://ci/internal/8231).

olivia_support: If we ship a patch, I'll proactively message the onboarding cohort and update quickstart with the patch version.

anya_ts: I'm opening PR to revert the export map change and add tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321 (WIP). Will add types field and an `edge` conditional.

lee_build: Also verify bundler paths: webpack/rollup/esbuild differ on how they use `exports` + `module`/`main` fields. Add a tiny matrix job `node12/node16/node18/edge` to smoke test packaging + types.

nate_sdk: thanks. I'll hold off merging the sample update until the patched package is published.

olivia_support: please cc support when patch goes out so we can mark tickets as blocked->fix.

anya_ts: Plan: revert in a revert PR in next 20m, publish 3.0.2 ESM-first patch after CI, and add the packaging smoke test to release pipeline. ETA ~1h if tests pass.

lee_build: Also add a lint rule in repo to flag adding `node`/`require` without `import` mapping in `exports`. Would have prevented this.

nate_sdk: great catch team. shipping this quickly will save a stream of onboarding frustration. :slightly_smiling_face:
